title: Soda Firing Workshop - Glazing in Soda with Maya Elin
source_quote: Soda Firing Workshop - Glazing in Soda with Maya Elin, Online: Oct 3 & 24, On Site at BCS: Nov 13-15 $440.00
evidence_sentence: A multi-day soda firing workshop Nov 13-15 includes clay-body discussion, pre-firing zoom sessions, glazing, kiln loading and firing, and unload.
evidence_quote: This multi-day workshop will focus on exploring glazing pieces that are fired in the soda kiln and will include updated information, recipes, and glazes from last years workshop.
summary: Multi-day soda-firing workshop with pre-workshop Zoom sessions on clay and glaze, in-person glazing and loading at BCS on Nov 13-15, and full participation in firing and unload. One half-cubic-foot kiln space included; additional space available for a fee. Workshop sold out.
pay_text: $440.00 includes one half cubic foot of kiln space
how_to_join: Page shows sold out; no registration link provided
commitment: Oct 3 & 24 Zoom · Nov 13 evening · Nov 14 load and fire · Nov 15 unload
